stories.title: Street Fighter - Official 'Love of Street Fighter' Featurette - IGN
stories.summary: Take a look at the 'Love of Street Fighter' Featurette for Street Fighter, the upcoming action-fighting movie based on the hit video game series distributed by Paramount Pictures. Hear from the cast about their love of Street Fighter being brought to the live-action rendition of Street Fighter, in theaters on October 16.Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!Street Fighter stars Noah Centineo, Andrew Koji, Callina Liang, Joe “Roman Reigns” Anoai, David Dastmalchian, Cody Rhodes, Andrew Schulz, Orville Peck, Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, Jason Momoa, and more. The film is directed by Kitao Sakurai and produced by Mary Parent, Cale Boyter, Jason Momoa, Takayuki Nakayama, and Stefan Makhoul.Street Fighter is in theaters on October 16.

stories.title: These guides can help you cut off tech that’s collecting your data.
stories.summary:
The Electronic Frontier Foundation’s Opt Out October tips go over settings to change in AI tools and browsers, decentralized social media platforms to try out, and suggestions for more private alternatives to popular apps. There’s also a guide on how you can switch to Linux, which could potentially save an old Windows 10 PC, like my ThinkPad, on top of improving your data privacy.
